_note: Commutation of a pension from an insurer's pension fund, under other sources: deducted in full (D-196; rulebook OS-COMMUT-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.93(1)(g) "for income in the nature of commutation of pension received from a fund as specified in Schedule VII (Table: Sl. No. 3), the entire amount" (p.142); Schedule VII Sl. 3: "Any fund, by whatever name called, set up by the Life Insurance Corporation of India on or after the 1st August, 1996 or any other insurer under a pension scheme". The salary head's counterpart is RET-COMMUTED-PENSION-FUND (s.19(1) Table Sl. 9). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10A)(iii) "any payment in commutation of pension received from a fund under clause (23AAB)" (thc p.72) — an exemption, not a s.57 deduction, which takes the same amount out of income; its introducedBy as RET-COMMUTED-PENSION-FUND's. Every regime.

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2023 (8 of 2023), s.52 — the new regime of s.115BAC(1A), whose s.115BAC(2)(i) does not exclude s.10(10) to (10C), so the entry applies in every regime
